description: Sunburst visualizes hierarchical data as concentric rings where each segment represents a share of the parent. It is effective when users need both top-level composition and deeper branch-level detail. Sunburst fits category trees, product hierarchies, org structures, and nested taxonomy analysis. It presents depth and proportion together for faster hierarchical insight. ### Key features - Color mode options: **same values share colors** or **color by level-1 branches**. - Toggle **values**, **labels**, and **center total** independently. - Fine-tune center summary placement with **total label offset**. - Control readability with adjustable **node opacity**. - Separate color settings for **node labels** and **center total label**. **Stay up to date!** Contact: support@appsforpowerbi.com Website: https://appsforpowerbi.infotopics.com/
